title: Error envelope
description: Body returned for any 4xx/5xx response. The HTTP status code carries the error class; the envelope carries a stable machine code and a human message. An endpoint may add its own keys beside `error` (the compile routes return `success` and the xelatex `log`), so only the `error` object itself is closed.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable slug (snake_case). Safe to switch on in clients.

details.description: Optional structured context (any JSON value): field errors, limits, ids, etc.
